signals.summary: Oracle's global head count fell by 21,000 between May 2025 and May 2026, including attrition and layoffs.
Restructuring and severance costs rose 391% year over year to about $1.8 billion.
Oracle raised $50 billion in debt to fund its data center infrastructure buildout.
Tens of thousands of Oracle employees were notified of role eliminations on March 31, 2026 across multiple countries.
TD Cowen estimated the March 2026 layoffs would hit 20,000 to 30,000 employees, roughly 18 percent of the workforce.
Reporting in September 2026 described another round of Oracle layoffs alongside a strong quarter.
